description: Application for a permit to operate a farmers market in Lincoln-Lancaster County.

permit_details.payment_note: When you provide a check as payment, you authorize us to use the information from your check to make a one-time electronic fund transfer from your account or to process the payment as a check transaction. Funds may be withdrawn as soon as the same day you make your payment, and you will not receive your check back.

steps.prompt: First, is this a new application, a renewal, or an addition?
What is the name of your market and its location?
Please provide the day(s) and time of operation, along with the season's opening and ending dates.
Who is the contact person for the organization, and what is their address, phone number, and email address?
Please provide a list of vendors selling home-prepared food or drink. For each vendor, I'll need their name, the food products they sell, and if they have approved training.
